source_evidence: When you push that enter key, your order is sent over the Internet to your broker -- who in turn decides which market to send it to for execution.
question: Misconception: When I submit an online stock order, it goes directly to the market and executes instantly at the price I saw on screen.
answer: Your order is sent to your broker, who decides which market to send it to. Execution takes time, and the stock price can change while the order is on its way, so you may not receive the price you saw on screen.
